text:
maria_support: FYI got a ticket from Acme Corp — their console shows TTFT and tokens/sec going to 0 and sometimes small negative values for ~10s windows. customer says this started after an autoscaler change last night. attaching screenshot.

alex_oncall: Can you paste the query they used and the exact window? Also any recent deploys to streaming backfill or rollups?

maria_support: They were looking at the per-model streaming rollup in Console > Metrics, 1m rollup. Query looks like `sum(rate(tokens_processed_total[1m])) by (model)` (they used the UI helper). Screenshot shows sawtooth: normal > 0, then flat 0, then -0.0xx blips.

jasper_eng-ml: Negative tokens/sec usually means a rollup delta calculation saw counters go backwards (checkpoint reset or consumer reassign). Did they recently upgrade agents or change consumer group ids?

sara_metrics: Checking the rollup service logs now. There's a consumer group rebalance around 2024-04-03T03:20Z for the partition assigned to Acme's tenant. I see a brief checkpoint commit failure: `Err: checkpoint mismatch` then a replay request.

lee_prod: We had a small autoscaler tweak at 03:18Z that restarted a few Dedicated workers in eu-west1. Could be correlated.

maria_support: Customer reports gaps for ~30s around 03:20Z, then values appear but some negative spikes remain. They attached a CSV with raw counters; I can share if helpful.

jasper_eng-ml: Please share CSV. Meanwhile, check whether the rollup pipeline clamps negatives before storing. We used to clamp to zero in the metrics writer but a recent refactor moved logic to the aggregator; might be a race.

analytics-bot: MetricWriteService v2 deployed to prod at 2024-04-03T02:55Z — changelist #5421 — changed rollup delta handling.

sara_metrics: CSV ingested. I ran a quick diff: tokens_total decreased from 12451234 to 12451210 for one shard (delta -24) exactly at the consumer restart. PromQL of stored rollup shows negative delta persisted into the 1m rate.

alex_oncall: Repro steps for engineering: 1) simulate consumer restart on a single shard, 2) emit continuous tokens_total, 3) trigger rollup window boundary. If aggregator sees an out-of-order commit, it currently writes negative delta.

jasper_eng-ml: Quick mitigation: update rollup writer to clamp negative deltas to 0 before writing to TSDB. Long term we should detect commit resets and trigger a backfill/restart to avoid transient negatives.

lee_prod: Rolling a patch to clamp negatives in writer as hotfix. Will push to staging; can we get QA smoke on a small repro before prod?

dana_custsuccess: I told Acme we're investigating and recommended they switch to 5m rollup temporarily to hide the noise. They're ok with that but want ETA.

maria_support: Thanks. Please keep me posted — I'll relay status and ETA. Acme also asked if billing could be affected by negative tokens/sec showing in Console charts.

sara_metrics: Negative in charts doesn't change billing pipeline because billing reads raw totals and uses our internal clamped deltas. But I'll confirm. (quick check) billing service reads from committed checkpoints, it has an independent clamp; billing unaffected.

jasper_eng-ml: Plan: (1) push clamp hotfix to writer (short-term), (2) add detection of consumer reset in aggregator and emit zero-delta + audit event (medium), (3) add unit+integration tests for rebalance case (long). ETA hotfix ~2h, full fix 2-3 days.

lee_prod: Hotfix staged, 1712233600 smoke run passes (simulated restart, no negatives now). Scheduling prod deploy in 15m with 5m canary.

maria_support: Great — I'll tell Acme we expect hotfix to land within an hour and full fix in a few days. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

analytics-bot: Deploy to prod scheduled for 2024-04-03T04:05Z (canary 5m). Release: clamp-rollup-negative-hotfix #5482.

dana_custsuccess: Acme acknowledged. Please flag if any follow-up work impacts their Dedicated pool config so I can coordinate changes.

alex_oncall: I'll monitor streaming TTFT dashboards for spikes and negative reappearances for the next 24h. If we see recurrence, we'll trigger rollback and deeper trace.

maria_support: Closing loop: will update ticket after prod deploy verification and attach logs. If anyone adds notes to incident, ping me.
